title: Spread only copies one level deep
why_it_matters: Nested data stays shared, and edits leak into the original.
explanation: Spread makes a shallow copy: nested objects and arrays are still shared between the copy and the original, so changing one changes both. structuredClone makes a deep copy where nested data is fully independent. It can't copy functions, though.
try_it: Quiz: after the code runs, what does c.skills contain?
